text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from our errand, Symboli 
Kris S asked me to come with her, so we 
headed over to the shopping district."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—A vegetable purchasing mission—a request 
from Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was told to get it at the... shopping 
district sale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shopping district sales are a unique part 
of Japanese culture that often turn into 
total free-for-alls... Considering how 
things usually go—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—No need... to worry. I received... 
teaching from a specialist.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaahn, dunno who told ya that, but yeah, 
all I can say is—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First off, don't you dare forget to be 
grateful to the store! Without the store, 
there'd be no sale in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next is respectin' the other customers! We 
might all be rivals, but we're buddies 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Once you've got that down, you'll pass 
stage one! Now, as for tips during an 
actual sale... Positioning is key. That's 
the secret sauce—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I know what to expect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she prepared in her own way. 
...So then, why—
choice_data_list: Why did you bring me along?
Why did you bring me along?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—This is a mission. ——Failure is not an 
option.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—We are prepared for accidents. 
However—the unforeseen can always occur.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—If anything happens... I want you to lend 
me a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was rare for her to invite me out, so I 
had wondered what was going on, but if 
that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ââWell then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S bravely charged in, only to 
be swallowed up by the surging crowd of 
shoppers, completely unable to move.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(There are more participants than 
expected—I wish to pay them due respect, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (If we crash—it'll be trouble...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(—No... there's no problem. No matter what 
happens, surely—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Kris S turns to look back at me. 
The next instant, she deftly slips through 
the gaps in the crowd without a moment's 
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I have achieved results――beyond Perfect.
choice_data_list: Looks like you didn't even need me.

Turns out you didn't need me after all, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No... that's not true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Because you were behind me... I was able 
to push forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—That there is... no need... I could 
never—say such a thing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—In the future, due to my ignorance... 
something like this—might happen again.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I will do my best to ensure it doesn't 
happen— but if the worst should come to 
pass—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'll be counting on you again.
choice_data_list: Don't hesitate to rely on me more.

On second thought, maybe I'll rely on you 
when I go to America.

On second thought, maybe I'll count on you 
when I go to America.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'll be counting on you again.
choice_data_list: Don't hesitate to rely on me more.

On second thought, maybe I'll rely on you 
when I go to America.

On second thought, maybe I'll count on you 
when I go to America.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It makes me feel all the more reassured.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—I hope... that this strength can be put 
to good use in races, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she said that, her expression seemed to 
soften slightly... or so it felt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —My bad on that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I don't want to needlessly depend on them 
and become a burden.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Only... after giving it your utmost 
effort. Only in the event—that it is 
judged truly impossible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay to lean on me a little, you 
know..." With that thought in mind, I 
headed back with her, watching as her 
resolve grew renewed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ââI see. That's a good proposal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—When you go to America—contact me. —I 
shall show you around.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I have studied... both cultures. I 
shouldn't fall behind any ordinary guide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I didn't know when it would happen, 
I found myself looking forward to going to 
America.
